page.layout: One printed page, a dedication page set centred in the text block; below the title block a page number line "* 2" with catchword "Ad" at the right; no margin notes; faint show-through from the reverse page at the right and centre, not transcribed.
page.notes: Title block set in large spaced capitals and italics; the first line is italic. The "Ad" at the foot is a catchword, and "* 2" is the signature/page mark. Show-through from the verso is ignored.
